name: Reflexión Ocular
description: Analiza reflexiones oculares para detectar inconsistencias de video deepfake
algorithm: Eye Reflection Consistency — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes eye reflections (corneal specular highlights) for deepfake detection:

1. **Specular Highlight Detección**: Corneal reflections (Purkinje images) are detected in each eye per frame. These bright spots on the curved corneal surface reflect the ambient light environment — creating miniature images of light sources visible in high-resolution video.

2. **Bilateral Reflection Consistencia**: Both eyes of the same person should show consistent specular reflections — same light sources, similar positions adjusted for inter-ocular distance, and consistent highlight shapes. Deepfake generators often produce eyes independently, creating reflection inconsistencies (different number of highlights, different positions, different shapes between left and right eyes).

3. **Físico Reflection Modelado**: Corneal reflections should be physically consistent with the scene illumination: (a) positions determined by light source locations via reflection geometry, (b) shapes following corneal curvature, (c) brightness proportional to light source intensity. The method verifies these physical constraints. AI-generated reflections may violate geometric reflection laws.

4. **Temporal Reflection Seguimiento**: As the head moves, corneal reflections should shift smoothly according to the changing viewing angle. The method tracks reflection positions across frames — they should follow smooth trajectories consistent with rigid body motion. Deepfakes may produce reflections that jump erratically or remain stationary during head movement.

5. **Environment Consistencia Cross - Check**: Corneal reflections provide information about the scene environment. The method cross-checks reflections between both eyes and against visible scene lighting. Inconsistencies between reflected and visible light sources indicate manipulation or generation artifacts.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante eye reflection consistency analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
